reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Oil: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 200ml
reviews.text: This cleansing oil is amazing. It melts makeup and sunscreen easily without irritating my skin. It feels gentle, doesn’t clog pores, and leaves my skin soft and clean, not greasy or dry. I really enjoy using it.
reviews.zh: 呢支卸妝油真係好正。輕鬆卸走化妝品同防曬，唔會刺激到我塊皮膚。感覺好溫和，唔會塞毛孔，皮膚用完軟滑乾淨，又唔油笠又唔乾。我真係好鍾意用。

感覺毛孔變得乾淨咗！
之後都會繼續配合潔面一齊用，目標係零毛孔！
